texts.name: Mukao
texts.biography: A general serving Lord Hiroshi, Mukao has made his forte military intelligence, and always seems to be one step ahead of the enemy, much to the delight of his daimyo. How he gains such good intelligence is not known, but he is suspected of having a vast network of undercover spies thoughout the island of Hashima – that or he is league with powerful divinatory magic. His latest assignment has seen him tasked with keeping watch over Irina, daughter of Duke Slava of Griffin and wife of Duke Gerhart of Wolf, a duty that he seems happy to undertake. "Know you enemy's mind and you need not know his sword" is his motto.

specialty.name: Scouting
specialty.description: Increases the scouting range by 1 for every 6 levels of the hero.
